descriptor: An AI-powered platform for creating and promoting Islamic content, focusing on Kashmiri-speaking Muslims.

requirements.statement: The system must generate engaging Islamic video ideas using AI.
The system must create scripts for Islamic videos using AI.
The system must produce Quran and Hadith educational content using AI.
The system must prepare subtitles for videos using AI.
The system must design thumbnails for videos using AI.
The system must develop content for YouTube and other social media platforms.
The system must use AI-powered analytics to understand audience interests.
The system must monitor video performance using AI.
The system must improve engagement strategies using AI insights.
The system must identify strategies to increase subscribers using AI.
The system must flag content generation and analysis for human review when uncertain.
The system must allow human approval of all content proposals before publishing.
The system must connect to YouTube for content distribution.

releases.demo: Demonstrate AI-generated video ideas and script creation with human review in place.
releases.goal: Establish core content creation capabilities and ensure human review process.
releases.name: Initial Setup and Basic Content Creation

releases.demo: Showcase a complete video production with subtitles and thumbnails, ready for YouTube.
releases.goal: Expand content creation to include full video production and distribution.
releases.name: Advanced Content Creation and Distribution

releases.demo: Demonstrate AI analytics providing insights on audience interests and engagement strategies.
releases.goal: Implement analytics to understand audience and improve engagement.
releases.name: Analytics and Audience Engagement

releases.demo: Show AI-driven strategies to increase subscribers and optimize content reach.
releases.goal: Enhance strategies for subscriber growth using AI insights.
releases.name: Subscriber Growth and Strategy Optimization

releases.demo: Show full platform operation with all features integrated and optimized for user experience.
releases.goal: Finalize platform integration and optimize all features for seamless operation.
releases.name: Full Platform Integration and Optimization

stories.title: Generate AI-powered video ideas
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to generate video ideas, so that I can create engaging Islamic content.
acceptance: Given the AI system, when prompted, then it generates a list of video ideas.
Given an inappropriate idea, when flagged, then it is removed from the list.
Trust: All generated ideas are logged for review.
failure_paths: AI fails to generate any ideas
stories.task_guidance: Implement AI model to generate video ideas based on Islamic content themes.

stories.title: Create AI-generated video scripts
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to create video scripts, so that I can produce content efficiently.
acceptance: Given a video idea, when processed, then the system generates a script.
Given an incomplete script, when reviewed, then it is flagged for human completion.
Trust: All scripts are logged for review.
failure_paths: Generated scripts are not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Develop script generation module using AI language models.

stories.title: Flag content for human review
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want the system to flag uncertain content for review, so that I can ensure accuracy.
acceptance: Given a generated script, when uncertain, then it is flagged for review.
Given a flagged item, when reviewed, then it is either approved or rejected.
Trust: All flagged items are logged with reviewer actions.
failure_paths: System fails to flag uncertain content
Flagged content is not visible to reviewers
stories.task_guidance: Implement flagging mechanism for uncertain content and log review actions.

stories.title: Produce Quran and Hadith educational content
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to produce educational content, so that I can teach effectively.
acceptance: Given a script, when processed, then the system produces educational content.
Given incorrect content, when reviewed, then it is flagged for correction.
Trust: All produced content is logged for review.
failure_paths: Produced content is not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Use AI to generate educational content based on scripts and Islamic texts.

stories.title: Prepare AI-generated subtitles
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to prepare subtitles, so that my videos are accessible.
acceptance: Given a video, when processed, then the system generates subtitles.
Given incorrect subtitles, when reviewed, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All subtitles are logged for review.
failure_paths: Generated subtitles are not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Develop subtitle generation module using AI language models.

stories.title: Design AI-generated thumbnails
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to design thumbnails, so that my videos attract viewers.
acceptance: Given a video, when processed, then the system generates a thumbnail.
Given an inappropriate thumbnail, when reviewed, then it is flagged for redesign.
Trust: All thumbnails are logged for review.
failure_paths: Generated thumbnails are not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Implement AI model to generate video thumbnails based on content themes.

stories.title: Distribute content to YouTube
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want to distribute content to YouTube, so that I can reach a wider audience.
acceptance: Given a completed video, when ready, then it is uploaded to YouTube.
Given a failed upload, when retried, then it succeeds or logs an error.
Trust: All uploads are logged with status.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate with YouTube API for content distribution.

stories.title: Analyze audience interests using AI
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to analyze audience interests, so that I can tailor content.
acceptance: Given audience data, when analyzed, then the system provides insights.
Given incorrect insights, when reviewed, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All analysis results are logged for review.
failure_paths: Analysis results are not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Develop analytics module to process audience data and generate insights.

stories.title: Monitor video performance using AI
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to monitor video performance, so that I can improve content.
acceptance: Given video data, when monitored, then the system provides performance metrics.
Given incorrect metrics, when reviewed, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All performance data is logged for review.
failure_paths: Performance data is not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Implement performance monitoring using AI to track video metrics.

stories.title: Improve engagement strategies using AI insights
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want to improve engagement strategies, so that I can increase audience interaction.
acceptance: Given AI insights, when applied, then engagement strategies are updated.
Given ineffective strategies, when reviewed, then they are flagged for revision.
Trust: All strategy changes are logged for review.
failure_paths: Strategy changes are not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Use AI insights to refine and implement new engagement strategies.

stories.title: Identify strategies to increase subscribers using AI
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want AI to identify strategies to increase subscribers, so that I can grow my audience.
acceptance: Given audience data, when analyzed, then the system suggests subscriber growth strategies.
Given ineffective strategies, when reviewed, then they are flagged for revision.
Trust: All strategy suggestions are logged for review.
failure_paths: Strategy suggestions are not flagged for review
stories.task_guidance: Develop AI module to analyze data and suggest subscriber growth strategies.

stories.title: Finalize platform integration and optimization
stories.narrative: As an educator, I want the platform fully integrated and optimized, so that I can use it seamlessly.
acceptance: Given the platform, when fully integrated, then all features work seamlessly.
Given integration issues, when identified, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All integration changes are logged for review.
stories.task_guidance: Ensure all system components are integrated and optimized for performance.

stories.title: Establish content approval and audit trail
stories.narrative: As a content manager, I want to ensure all content goes through an approval process and is logged, so that we maintain quality and accountability.
acceptance: Given a new video script is generated, When it is flagged for review, Then it must be approved by a content manager before publication.
Given a video script is approved, When it is published, Then an entry is created in the audit log with the approval details.
Trust: Given a video script is flagged, When it is approved or rejected, Then the action is recorded in the audit trail.
stories.task_guidance: Implement an approval workflow for video scripts with logging to the audit trail. Ensure all actions are recorded in the audit log table.
